move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You close by heading back to the machines—it sounds like you value a direct discussion that keeps you focused on production. We want a competitive agreement without unnecessary back-and-forth. How could flexibility on delivery timing help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Hallo, 42 days lead time gives us breathing room on the machines, and we can do DAP. Since you have good volume and we want the work, we can drop the price to €15.40. But we need 14 days payment to keep the cash moving. Our main offer stands at a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Alternatively, a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.
Please let me explain.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We have already taken that should cost data into account.
We appreciate the confirmation of the 6,000 units annual volume and share your ambition for a long-term partnership.
To move towards your target, we can reduce our price to €15.50 per unit, but we must return the lead time to 45 days to optimize our production and absorb the concession.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €15.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 45 days net, a Lieferzeit of 42 days, and delivery EXW. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. This offer remains valid for 30 days.
